Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this masterclass you understand southern vimana, enclosure and gopura development.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. It can be given online or at your venue, as a single session or as part of a series.

What it covers

  • Early forms
  • Chola comparison
  • Plans and inscriptions

How the time is spent

  1. Early forms 30 min

    Pallava structural and rock-cut precedents.

    You: arrange chronology

  2. Chola comparison 60 min

    Temple volume versus later enclosure/gopuram growth.

    You: compare complexes

  3. Plans and inscriptions 30 min

    Trace patronage and social history.

    You: label plan

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

An activity sheet to keep.
